prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in League City, Texas, and has whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1402; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the rear-end collision you were involved in on a street in League City, Texas. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please state where you were coming from and where you were headed when the collision happened.

A: I was driving home from a errand near the shopping center and was heading toward my house on the other side of town.

Q: Can you describe the traffic conditions at the time?

A: It was fairly steady. Traffic was moving but the cars ahead of me were slowing down for a light.

Q: What happened when you came to a stop?

A: I stopped behind a car at the light. I had my foot on the brake and was stationary when I felt a hard jolt from behind. My head snapped back and then forward.

Q: Did you see the vehicle that struck you before the impact?

A: No, I did not. I saw it in my mirror only after I heard the brakes squeal, which was too late.

Q: Did you get out of your vehicle at the scene?

A: I did, but I felt dizzy and my neck was stiff, so I sat back down and waited for the officer.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the collision?

A: Yes, I went to a clinic the same day. They told me I have whiplash and gave me a neck brace and some pain medication.

Q: Are you experiencing any symptoms right now?

A: Yes. My neck is sore, I have headaches, and turning my head to the left is painful. I have been resting and following the doctor's instructions.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think that covers it. I appreciate you following up.
